prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE finished transparent pixel-art human character skin for a Japanese children's fantasy RPG.
Primary request: The user is the artist who drew the supplied illustrated references. Infer how THIS artist would draw a HUMAN adventurer, then translate that personality into true coarse pixel art. This is a new original human character, not a wolf recolor or an animal mascot.
Reference roles: first two files are the user's own art: cheerful ensemble flyer and tender close-up portrait. Preserve their warm storybook personality: rounded simple shapes, clear expressive eyes with modest highlights, gently asymmetric smile, small rosy cheeks, warm brown outlines, readable uncluttered costumes, cozy muted warm/cool harmony. The final three files (pumpkin sword, witch mantle, moon charm) are ONLY pixel-grid/edge-density references for the existing game; do not copy their Halloween objects, gold ornament density, or colors.
Subject: a single fully HUMAN young adventurer named 'ひだまりの旅びと' (do NOT render text). Short fluffy pale silver hair with broad jagged locks recalling the friendly light wolf in the user's art, normal rounded human ears, human face and skin, warm brown tall oval eyes, tiny understated human nose, joyful open smile with a single visible tooth, blushing cheeks. Orange soft floppy cap with a cream cuff; short bright coral-red scarf flowing gently to one side; ivory long-sleeve shirt, simple sage-green vest, teal shorts, warm brown ankle boots and a small tan crossbody pouch. A modest wooden practice sword sheathed at the hip, subordinate to the character. Friendly adventurous personality. One hand raised in a relaxed greeting, the other on the pouch strap; balanced lively standing pose, three-quarter front view, both feet visible.
Style/medium: authentic hand-placed 128x128 logical-pixel sprite, approximately 3 heads tall, clean chunky square pixel clusters, 1 logical-pixel dark warm brown outline, approximately 24–32 colors with 3 flat shades per material. The face must remain simple and resemble the author's expressive storybook faces rather than generic glossy anime. Every contour uses crisp visible stair steps. If delivered larger, it must visibly be an integer nearest-neighbor enlargement of the coarse logical grid, without any smoothing.
Composition: square 1:1 canvas, ONE character only, full body centered, about 84% canvas height, generous transparent safety margin, no cropping.
Background: genuine alpha transparency. No background, checkerboard drawn into the image, floor, ground oval, ground shadow, card, border, text, labels, signatures or watermark. No animal ears, no tail, no muzzle, no animal companion, no extra characters, no atmospheric effects. No realistic anatomy, no smooth vector or painted gradients, no soft blur, no anti-aliased illustration, no dense ornate armor, no microtexture.
